concerns: Docs-only, one-file change: ce-simplify-code and the thermonuclear pair do not run (no runtime code). Acceptance is proven on the sandbox repo sjawhar/legion-smoke via the merged PR/main diff, not a unit suite.

Error guard from spec: create smoke/S392670114-1.md exactly once; verified none exists on the branch (ls smoke/ | grep S392670114 -> none). Any change touching a file outside smoke/ is out of scope and review rejects it.

Per spec, the dependent leaf S392670114-5 carries the file addition; this root plan records the concrete change and tracks integration onto current main and sign-off once merged and production-checked.

acceptanceCriteria.command: legion gh -- pr diff <pr> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke ; and on main: jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" diff --from main@origin --to @ --summary
acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A new Markdown file exists under smoke/ holding a single line naming S392670114-1.
acceptanceCriteria.negativeControl: A diff that adds a second file or edits a file outside smoke/ fails review as out of scope.
acceptanceCriteria.proof: Diff shows exactly one added file smoke/S392670114-1.md with one line naming the issue and no other change.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: sjawhar/legion-smoke sandbox repo; merged pull request / current-main diff

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: If review requests it, that same file gains one appended line and nothing else changes.
acceptanceCriteria.negativeControl: Appending to any other file, or a second line, is rejected in review.
acceptanceCriteria.proof: Updated diff shows one appended line to smoke/S392670114-1.md and no other change.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: sjawhar/legion-smoke sandbox repo; updated pull request diff

plan.integration: On current main after the child S392670114-5 merges, smoke/S392670114-1.md is present with its issue-naming line; the tester confirms against main, not merely the child PR's CI checks. Implementer opens the PR with body line 'Dispatch: S392670114-1' and proves AC1 on the sandbox surface before its phase completes.
plan.ordering: T1 is the only implementation step. Test verifies AC1 (and AC2 if a review append is requested) on the sandbox diff surface. Review confirms single-file scope. Merger publishes READY; implementer runs the post-merge production check on the merged main.

tasks.detail: Create smoke/S392670114-1.md containing a single line that names this issue, e.g. 'Stage 3 smoke proof for S392670114-1.'. Do not modify any other file. Confirmed no file matching S392670114 currently exists under smoke/.
tasks.title: Add the smoke marker file

implement: legion-worker: drives the implementer's push and PR-open procedure and the docs-only handling for this single Markdown file; because the diff is docs-only, ce-simplify-code and the thermonuclear pair are correctly skipped. No legion-smoke domain skill covers Markdown authoring.
review: legion-worker: defines the reviewer's per-round single-submission, individual thread disposition, and docs-only skip of the thermo pair; the review confirms exactly one new smoke/ file with one issue-naming line and nothing else changed. No domain test skill applies to a one-line Markdown addition.

workflowRecommendation: Single trivial docs-only task: add one Markdown file under smoke/. No sub-planning; the adopted child S392670114-5 carries the file addition and this root owns integration and sign-off.
